### Top Donor CRMs with Integrated Text Messaging

Several Donor CRMs offer built-in or seamlessly integrated SMS/text messaging for fundraising, donor engagement, volunteer recruitment, and events. These tools emphasize high open rates (often 98% within minutes), text-to-give (e.g., keyword-based donations), personalization, segmentation, and bi-directional syncing. Below, I've summarized the most relevant options from the search results, focusing on DonorPerfect (a core CRM) and compatible add-ons, plus other CRMs with native texting.

#### 1. **DonorPerfect (with DP Text or Rally Corp Integration)**
   - **Overview**: DonorPerfect is a leading nonprofit CRM for donor management, gifts, and fundraising. It integrates bi-directionally with SMS tools for text-to-give, pledges, volunteer signups, and automated messaging.
   - **Key Text Features**:
     | Feature | DP Text | Rally Corp |
     |---------|---------|------------|
     | **Text-to-Give** | Keyword-based (e.g., text "GIVE" to donate) | Keyword to short code (e.g., 24365), syncs donations back to CRM |
     | **Engagement** | Custom keywords, event invites, contests, gamified hunts | Tap-to-donate (NFC), 2-way messaging, photo/video texts, automated thank-yous |
     | **Analytics** | Reports, goal meters, segmentation | Donor segmentation, engagement signals for follow-ups |
     | **Setup** | One-time opt-in; syncs to donor records | Mobile layer on top of DonorPerfect; keeps CRM as system of record |
   - **Pricing**: Custom; try DP Text by texting "CORAL" to 844-585-0681.
   - **Best For**: Nonprofits wanting CRM-native texting without switching platforms. Available in US/Canada.
   - **Links**: [DP Text](https://www.donorperfect.com/integrations/email-marketing/dp-text/), [Rally](https://www.rallycorp.com/integrations/donorperfect).

#### 2. **Constant Contact SMS (DonorPerfect Integration)**
   - **Overview**: Pairs with DonorPerfect for SMS campaigns alongside email.
   - **Key Features**: Personalized reminders, event updates, text-to-give links; AI content generator, analytics (clicks, unsubscribes), opt-in forms, local phone numbers.
   - **Stats**: 98% read rate; 95% of marketers see revenue boost.
   - **Best For**: Time-sensitive outreach like giving challenges.
   - **Link**: [Constant Contact SMS](https://www.donorperfect.com/factsheets/constant-contact-sms/).

#### 3. **Other CRMs with Native Texting**
   | CRM | Key Text Features | Best Use Case | Link |
   |-----|-------------------|---------------|------|
   | **Andar/360** | Personalized messages (name, giving history), engagement tracking, auto-follow-ups, response matching to records | Donor/volunteer outreach, workflows | [Andar Texting](https://andarsoftware.com/texting/) |
   | **Funraise** | Custom keywords (e.g., "DONATE"), automated responses with donation links, personalization, reminders, donor covers fees | Text-to-give campaigns, event thermometers | [Funraise](https://www.funraise.org/features/text-engagement) |
   | **DonorDock** | Bulk/individual texts for appeals, thank-yous, events; real-time engagement | Quick donor touches | [DonorDock](https://www.donordock.com/features/text-message-outreach) |
   | **Giveffect** | Text marketing with CRM segmentation, direct mail integration | All-in-one comms | [Giveffect](https://www.giveffect.com/marketing-and-communications-system) |

#### Recommendations
- **Start with DonorPerfect + DP Text/Rally** if you need a full CRM with robust texting—it's purpose-built for nonprofits and handles compliance (e.g., opt-ins).
- **General Tips**: Focus on personalization (e.g., donor names, suggested amounts), segmentation, and metrics like response rates. Texts outperform email (higher opens/responses) for 1:1 engagement.
- **Next Steps**: Test free trials (e.g., DP Text demo) and ensure TCPA compliance for opt-ins.

For more details or comparisons, provide your nonprofit size, budget, or specific needs (e.g., text-to-give focus).
